AttentionState.description: State of one camera candidate or of the whole station.
AttentionState.title: AttentionState

Calibration.description:
Per-camera calibration stored by the calibration wizard.

Head pose signals are reported relative to this neutral pose.
Calibration.title: Calibration

CameraRole.description: Fusion role. Exactly one camera per station is primary.
CameraRole.title: CameraRole

CaptureConfig.description:
Evidence capture: burst shape, JPEG quality and the in-memory ring.

The ring only ever lives in memory; nothing here enables recording.
CaptureConfig.title: CaptureConfig

ConsentPolicyInfo.description: The site's current consent policy text.
ConsentPolicyInfo.title: ConsentPolicyInfo

PpeProfile.description:
A PPE profile as the engine consumes it.

`signals` always holds an entry for every `SignalName` after validation
(missing ones are filled in as disabled). `thresholds` is the profile's
layer in threshold resolution, if it has one.
PpeProfile.title: PpeProfile

PpeProfileKind.description: Profile kinds; values match `ppe_profile.kind` in the schema.
PpeProfileKind.title: PpeProfileKind

ProfileThresholds.description:
A PPE profile and its fully resolved thresholds for this workstation.

Resolved on the server like the station-level `thresholds`, with this
profile as the PPE layer: defaults -> site -> this profile -> shift ->
workstation.
ProfileThresholds.title: ProfileThresholds

RoiPoint.description: One polygon vertex in normalized image coordinates (0-1, origin top-left).
RoiPoint.title: RoiPoint

RosterEntry.description: One active worker of the site, for offline login.
RosterEntry.title: RosterEntry

Shift.description:
A shift with its breaks.

Times are site-local and may cross midnight (`end_time` before
`start_time`). `days_of_week` uses 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday and names
the day the shift starts on.
Shift.title: Shift

ShiftBreak.description: A scheduled break inside a shift (site-local times).
ShiftBreak.title: ShiftBreak

ShiftThresholds.description: Fully resolved thresholds that apply while one shift is active.
ShiftThresholds.title: ShiftThresholds

SignalName.description: Every signal the engine can extract per camera per frame.
SignalName.title: SignalName

SignalSetting.description: Whether one signal is computed and how much it counts.
SignalSetting.title: SignalSetting

SiteSettings.description: Per-site settings with the schema defaults. Unknown keys are ignored.
SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings

ThresholdOverrides.description:
A partial `Thresholds`: only the keys one layer overrides.

This is the `values` of a `threshold_profile`. Each key is range-checked
here; cross-key rules are checked when the layers are resolved.
ThresholdOverrides.title: ThresholdOverrides

Thresholds.description: A complete, validated set of detection thresholds.
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

WorkstationInfo.description: The workstation this bundle is for.
WorkstationInfo.title: WorkstationInfo

EnrollRequest.description: `POST /enroll`: exchange the one-time enrollment token for a device secret.
EnrollRequest.title: EnrollRequest

EnrollResponse.description: The device secret is shown once; the device stores it with DPAPI.
EnrollResponse.title: EnrollResponse

AttentionEventPayload.description: A scan warning or a state episode.
AttentionEventPayload.title: AttentionEventPayload

AttentionState.description: State of one camera candidate or of the whole station.
AttentionState.title: AttentionState

BucketPayload.description: Seconds per state in one closed minute.
BucketPayload.title: BucketPayload

CameraHeartbeat.description: One camera in a heartbeat or health sample.
CameraHeartbeat.title: CameraHeartbeat

CameraStateSnapshot.description: One camera's view at an event (`attention_event.camera_states`).
CameraStateSnapshot.title: CameraStateSnapshot

CameraStatus.description: Status of one camera as reported in health and heartbeats.
CameraStatus.title: CameraStatus

DisputePayload.description: A worker's dispute of one of their events.
DisputePayload.title: DisputePayload

DisputeReasonCode.description:
Optional reason code on a dispute (`dispute.reason`, revision 2).

The values are the fixed choices of the workstation's "My record" screen,
so false-positive statistics can be counted by reason (scope 6).
DisputeReasonCode.title: DisputeReasonCode

EngineStatus.description: Status of the detection engine process (PLAN 1.8, 2.3).
EngineStatus.title: EngineStatus

ImagesWithheld.description: Why an event has no (or fewer) images (`attention_event.images_withheld`).
ImagesWithheld.title: ImagesWithheld

LocalAlertKind.description: Alerts the workstation raises itself; the server maps them to `alert.kind`.
LocalAlertKind.title: LocalAlertKind

LoginFailurePayload.description:
A failed worker login on the station (revision 2), for the server audit log.

Never carries what was typed: an unknown employee ID is often a PIN typed
into the ID field. `occurred_at` is the time of the attempt.
LoginFailurePayload.title: LoginFailurePayload

ScanOutcome.description: What a scan was recorded as. The scan is accepted in every case.
ScanOutcome.title: ScanOutcome

ScanPayload.description: A scan. `occurred_at` is `scanned_at`. No session: an unattributed scan.
ScanPayload.title: ScanPayload

SessionStartPayload.description: The item `id` is the session id; `occurred_at` is `started_at`.
SessionStartPayload.title: SessionStartPayload

UnknownEventItem.description: An item type this side does not know; the server answers `rejected`.
UnknownEventItem.title: UnknownEventItem

EventBatch.description: `POST /events:batch` body, typed. A retry resends the same `batch_id`.
EventBatch.title: EventBatch

EvidenceUploadHeaders.description: The metadata headers of one evidence upload.
EvidenceUploadHeaders.title: EvidenceUploadHeaders

AttentionState.description: State of one camera candidate or of the whole station.
AttentionState.title: AttentionState

CameraHeartbeat.description: One camera in a heartbeat or health sample.
CameraHeartbeat.title: CameraHeartbeat

CameraStatus.description: Status of one camera as reported in health and heartbeats.
CameraStatus.title: CameraStatus

EngineStatus.description: Status of the detection engine process (PLAN 1.8, 2.3).
EngineStatus.title: EngineStatus

RejectedConfig.description: A config bundle the client refused; the previous one stays active.
RejectedConfig.title: RejectedConfig

LiveStillCommand.description: Post one frame to `/live/{request_id}/frame`; never store it.
LiveStillCommand.title: LiveStillCommand

LiveVideoCommand.description: Open the live stream, only if the site setting allows it.
LiveVideoCommand.title: LiveVideoCommand

UnknownCommand.description: A command type this client does not know. It is logged and not executed.
UnknownCommand.title: UnknownCommand

HeartbeatResponse.description: Server time, the current config version and pending commands.
HeartbeatResponse.title: HeartbeatResponse

RawEventBatch.description: The batch envelope with unvalidated items (server side).
RawEventBatch.title: RawEventBatch

RotateSecretRequest.description: `POST /secret/rotate`: no body fields; the device is taken from the token.
RotateSecretRequest.title: RotateSecretRequest

RotateSecretResponse.description: The new secret. The old one stays valid for 10 minutes.
RotateSecretResponse.title: RotateSecretResponse

TokenResponse.description: A device JWT (15 minutes). `server_time` is optional for older servers.
TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
